$description: Semantic roles. Every entry resolves to a foundation token id — an LLM composing a page must reference these, never a raw hex/rgb value.

text.primary.usage: body copy, card titles, nav links, active tabs

text.heroTitle.usage: the h1 on /, /about, /careers, /pricing only — a slightly different near-black than text.primary; reproduced from live, not normalised away

text.secondary.usage: eyebrows, card body copy, captions, footer links

text.tertiary.usage: the hero heading's muted tail, inactive filter tabs, placeholders

text.onColor.usage: label on a dark pill button

text.mutedOlive.usage: /careers Open Roles department labels and role subtitles

surface.hover.usage: ghost-button hover; the /careers Open Roles band background

surface.panel.usage: the Control stage, the nav submenu panel, the hero news tag

surface.cardVisual.usage: the inner visual panel of a benefit card

border.card.usage: 1px card outline; the site uses a border instead of a shadow

border.field.usage: form inputs, the Control card's inner profile panel, About/Careers rules

accent.verified.usage: the blue verified badge on the Control agent card — the only saturated accent on the site

notes: type.eyebrow is deliberately NOT uppercase and carries no letter-spacing. src/index.css:90 records that this was re-measured against live and corrected from an earlier uppercase assumption.
text.heroTitle vs text.primary is a real two-value distinction on the source site, not a clone artefact — CLONE_SPEC.md:56 records both.
